messages.content: The downtown rental branch just said it is closing at 1:00 today because they are short-staffed. Can we still make the 12:30 return from La Jolla without turning the hotel move into a mess?

Yes. La Jolla to Little Italy is typically about 20-30 minutes late Monday morning, and a fuel stop should add roughly 10-15 minutes. I would allow another 15 minutes for unloading and traffic, so leaving the La Jolla hotel by 10:45 gives you a useful cushion.

Checkout is 11:00, the new room is not ready until at least 3:00, and we have both suitcases. The alternatives are the airport for another $47 plus a rideshare back, or keeping the car until tomorrow for $96 before parking.

The downtown return is the least disruptive and least expensive option. Since the Little Italy hotel already agreed to store both bags, you can complete the move before returning the car and avoid hauling luggage from the rental office.
Set the exact order. I do not want the fuel stop or bag handoff pushing us past closing.

Check out and load the car at 10:40. Depart La Jolla by 10:45, refuel near the freeway before entering downtown, and aim to reach the Little Italy hotel around 11:25. Leave both suitcases with the front desk, keep the claim tickets, and depart again by 11:40. Drive to the downtown branch and target an 11:55 return, leaving more than an hour before its 1:00 closing and 35 minutes before the scheduled 12:30 return.
Would it be safer to return the car first and take the bags from there?

Only if traffic is already materially delayed. Returning first would require arranging another ride with two suitcases and then repeating part of the route. With an on-time 10:45 departure, the hotel-first sequence is simpler and still has substantial margin.
Okay. What is the fallback trigger if traffic is bad when we leave?

Check the route at 10:40. If the estimated arrival at the Little Italy hotel is later than 11:40, skip the hotel stop, return the car downtown first, and take a rideshare with the suitcases to the hotel. Otherwise follow the planned sequence: checkout 10:40, depart 10:45, fuel, bag drop about 11:25, car return about 11:55, then walk or rideshare back and check in after 3:00. The airport surcharge and Tuesday extension are unnecessary unless the downtown branch becomes unreachable.
